description: Add an emoji reaction to a chat message. Requires message_id + reaction emoji name.

reaction.description: Emoji name (lowercase, no colons). E.g. 'joy', 'heart', '+1'. Required.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: add_chat_reaction
